title: View of notes, version 1
description: A view of the Markdown notes of a folder (NOTE-003), kept as a `.view.yaml` file of the folder: which notes, which properties as columns, their order, and how they are shown. Filters are comparisons, never code.

title.description: The name shown; the file name without `.view.yaml` when absent.

from.description: The folder of the notes, relative to the folder open, and where notes made from the view go; every note when absent.

where.description: Filters, all of them holding: `key = value`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `key contains text`, `key !contains text`, `has key`, `!has key`, `#tag`, `!#tag`. `today` is the day of today; links compare by the name of the note.

columns.description: Properties shown, in order; also `name`, `path`, `folder`, `modified`, `tags` and `tasks` (done/total).

sort.description: Columns to sort by, the first first; `-` before a column for the largest first. Notes without the value go last.

group.description: The property whose values make the columns of a board.

groups.description: The columns of the board, in this order, shown even when empty; the other values follow.
